=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the foreground man in a Facebook photograph posted 17 August 2026. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. Hiking photograph at Babia Gora; he is the named subject in the foreground. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Wojciech Pawlik portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Wojciech Pawlik Facebook portrait.jpg]].
